description: claude-modes V2 plugin hooks. UserPromptSubmit injects active mode's prose layer (R25). SessionStart runs Python orchestrator for worktree reconciliation (R27) + new-file scan (R20c) + contract anchor logging. PostToolUse Write offers adoption consent when Claude writes files at user-catalog paths (R20b). V1's PreToolUse(Task|Skill|Agent) gate is intentionally dropped — V2 reshapes catalogs via settings.local.json cascade, not via tool-dispatch interception.
